image:image.image:caption: Play and live-edit MilkDrop presets in your browser, with demo audio, hand-picked presets, and ways to react to your own music.

image:image.image:caption: Guide to browser support, lighter visual modes, and what to expect on older devices.

image:image.image:title: MilkDrop Presets, A–Z | Stims
image:image.image:caption: MilkDrop presets on Stims, by collection, by author and A–Z.

image:image.image:title: Learn to Write MilkDrop Presets — Free Course | Stims
image:image.image:caption: A free course in writing MilkDrop presets, from remixing with sliders to shaders. Every example runs live in your browser with nothing to install.

image:image.image:title: MilkDrop Online — Play and Edit Presets in Your Browser | Stims
image:image.image:caption: Run MilkDrop presets in your browser with nothing to install. Watch, play your own music, edit the equations, and import or export .milk files.

image:image.image:title: Stims vs Butterchurn vs projectM | Stims
image:image.image:caption: How Stims, Butterchurn, and projectM differ (browser app, embeddable renderer, and native library) and which one fits what you want to do.

image:image.image:title: Remix a MilkDrop Preset With No Code — Track 0 | Stims
image:image.image:caption: Fifteen minutes, no code: find a MilkDrop preset you love, drag its live sliders, remix it with credit preserved, and share it as a link.

image:image.image:title: How MilkDrop Works: Feedback, Pipeline, Decay — Track 1 | Stims
image:image.image:caption: The mental model behind every MilkDrop preset: the feedback loop, the per-frame and per-pixel pipeline, and what decay and time really do.

image:image.image:title: MilkDrop Motion: zoom, rot, dx, sx, warp — Track 2 | Stims
image:image.image:caption: Control how a MilkDrop preset moves with zoom, rot, dx/dy, sx/sy, and warp, plus a line-by-line dissection of a Geiss classic.

image:image.image:title: Audio-Reactive MilkDrop: Bass, Beats, Smoothing — Track 3 | Stims
image:image.image:caption: Make a MilkDrop preset react to music: audio bands, smoothing, beat detection without a beat detector, and measuring how reactive it really is.

image:image.image:title: MilkDrop Per-Pixel Warp Fields — Track 4 | Stims
image:image.image:caption: Per-pixel equations in MilkDrop: rad and ang, tunnels, ripples, and other warp fields that change with position across the screen.

image:image.image:title: MilkDrop Custom Waves and Shapes — Track 5 | Stims
image:image.image:caption: Draw with MilkDrop custom waves and custom shapes, and pass values from per-frame equations into them with the q-variable bridge.

image:image.image:title: MilkDrop Warp and Composite Shaders — Track 6 | Stims
image:image.image:caption: Write MilkDrop warp and composite shaders, the pair used by most of the catalog, with runnable examples and notes on what browsers support.

image:image.image:title: MilkDrop Masterworks Dissected — Track 7 | Stims
image:image.image:caption: Five celebrated MilkDrop presets taken apart: reaction-diffusion, tempo tracking, hand-rolled HSL, and more, to learn what makes them good.

image:image.image:title: Publishing MilkDrop Presets and Engine Compatibility — Track 8 | Stims
image:image.image:caption: What works in MilkDrop, projectM, Butterchurn, and Stims: a cross-engine compatibility matrix, performance advice, and how to publish your preset.

image:image.image:title: MilkDrop Technique Glossary | Stims
